import json, sys, time, io, resource
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import driver
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'contains(S00,S01) allow; match(S02,S03) drop;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
for u in range(1,1025):
    ev.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,u,1],'service':names[u%16]})
# 32768 contexts: 32 per unit
for u in range(1,1025):
    for r in range(1,33):
        ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,u,1],'rid':r})
# 4096 connections
for c in range(1,4097):
    ev.append({'op':'open','connection':[c,1]})
# 32768 sends: 8 per connection
for c in range(1,4097):
    for s in range(1,9):
        ev.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,c,1],'rid':1,'connection':[c,1],'stream':s,'destination':names[(c+s)%16]})
# 8192 files
for f in range(1,8193):
    ev.append({'op':'store','unit':[0,f,1],'rid':2,'file':[f,1]})
for i in range(0,20):
    ev.append({'op':'inspect'})
j={'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':ev}
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[j]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('events',len(ev),'input %.1f MiB'%(len(data)/1048576))
t=time.time()
buf=io.BytesIO(); w=driver.Writer(buf,chunk=1<<21)
driver.run(data,w); w.flush()
print('run %.2fs out %d bytes'%(time.time()-t,buf.tell()))
out=json.loads(buf.getvalue())
res=out['results'][0]['events']
bad=[i for i,r in enumerate(res) if r=={'error':'rejected'}]
print('rejected events:',len(bad), bad[:6])
print('final inspect:', json.dumps(res[-1]))
print('peak rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
PYEOF
time python3 stress4.py
